scope: Phase 5 synthetic workforce, selected clinical resource use and inventory inputs; no financial postings or analytics solution
review_authority: Codex, expressly designated by the user to review and finalize the synthetic design; no licensed clinical endorsement
source_capture: The staff_shift envelope is 70000 versions. Final attendance is retained for every modeled block; selected initial publications, all modeled absences/replacements and explicit late corrections retain earlier versions. A final-only row is unknown before its known_from, even though its planned timestamps are retained. Missing early history is unknown, not zero staffing. This is selected retained source history, not a complete HR/payroll census. Prewindow clinical context retains its accepted facts; resource costs and issue links before the opening boundary are outside this generation scope. Selected support shifts do not assert a complete hospital payroll or continuous contractor/EVS coverage.
nursing: 5.5 productive RN hours per occupied patient-day is the frozen fictional base. Acuity weights apply to observed shift-start census; one RN presence is the minimum on each active ACUTE, ICU and ED scope. ACUTE is the shared MEDICINE/SURGERY nursing pool. Critical-care nurses may cover ICU, ED or ACUTE; emergency nurses ED or ACUTE; medical-surgical nurses ACUTE, AMB or the selected circulating-OR role. OR captures surgeon and circulating RN only, not a complete anesthetic/operative team. These are synthetic workload and competency assumptions, not safe-staffing advice.
planning: Initial retained rosters use only lagged observations available at publication. Same-day callouts and changed assignment are source-known reactions. Retrospective integrated census/acuity hours are independently evaluated and never published as advance-known actual demand. Nurses are not removed from occupied patients to reconcile an hourly coverage gap.
time: Local 07:00/19:00 twelve-hour nominal rosters retain 11/13 elapsed hours across DST. A limited opening intersecting shift is context. Closing in-progress shifts retain observed actual_start, null actual_end, and zero finalized hours/cost; observed presence is evaluated only through cutoff. Unfinished attendance is not a fabricated next-year completion.
hours: Elapsed attended hours equal productive plus paid attended nonproductive plus unpaid break hours. Paid hours exclude unpaid breaks. Weekly overtime is a subset of paid hours above 40 in a Monday local workweek, split at week boundaries and across midnight/DST. It is not added to worked hours. Leave/absence has zero worked hours. Paid leave cost derives separately from the planned entitlement, capped at eight hours; it is not attended time.
costs: Use the worker assignment valid at service and known when the attendance revision is recorded. Employee nonphysician overtime adds a 0.5 loaded-rate premium; this is a fictional costing convention, not a statutory regular-rate calculation. Physician/contract/agency loaded rates are used once; agency burden is already in the accepted master rate. Late rate/attendance corrections append versions. Final/source-known views never sum all versions as expense. Reported six-place hours are the cost-input quantities. Split paid hours proportionally at a workweek boundary and assign the final micro-hour residual to the final part so the parts sum exactly to reported paid hours. The source rate is the service-start assignment snapshot, resolved using the attendance revision knowledge; this is the fictional shift-start-rate contract.
clinical_authorship: Physicians are source ordering/review clinicians; a represented working physician may cross-cover the facility. Actual operative authors must have the matching surgery specialty and cannot perform overlapping procedures. MED_ADMIN and selected OBSERVATION authors become eligible working RNs. Authorship is not a claim that the physician physically performed every lab/dispense. Appointment providers remain planned providers. The specialty-qualified attending of record is preserved and can be on call; it does not assert continuous physical presence. Actual recorded event authors and operative performers are linked to attendance. Operative-note authors are source reviewing physicians, not an assertion that every note is a complete surgeon-dictated operative report.
constraints: Thirty operating-unit case-cart stockouts and thirty circulating-nurse absence responses postpone observed operative starts. Two concurrent selected operative cases per facility is the configured capacity. The coordinated agenda moves actual performance/end/source clocks before workforce and inventory generation. Clinical notes remain fact-grounded; delays fit within existing care intervals, so discharge/bed times need not move. Any delay beyond an observed care boundary fails closed rather than retaining a stale discharge.
stock_scope: All modeled medication issues are recorded against the facility PHARM controlled stock pool; ward cabinets are not separate published stock locations. The clinical administration location remains derivable from bed intervals. Selected supply inventories are SUPPORT, DIAG and OR. Stock-location balances must not be presented as unmodeled individual ward-bin balances.
stock_rules: Opening and receipts establish item/lot/base-unit stock and immutable receipt cost/expiry. FEFO applies at every represented use. Routine orders use prior on-hand/in-flight quantities, configured planning rates and a two-day lead. Transfer and unopened-return pairs conserve quantity and valuation. A case cart is released only after its order is source-known; delayed arrival creates a real service delay. Cancelled/not-done administrations consume zero. MED_DISPENSE is take-home supply only. Medication source lines require a single lot per indivisible administration or whole prescription fill. Eligible FEFO therefore considers lots with sufficient quantity for that whole source fill; residual stock remains available to smaller subsequent fills and is never silently discarded. Supplies may span lots with separately counted issue groups. Known expiry within the replenishment lead is excluded from reorder stock.
consumption: Medication consumption equals actual dose divided by catalog strength. Supply rules count one serum tube and one preparation pad per distinct modeled specimen, two gloves per specimen/procedure, one drape per actual operative case, and one selected gown per recorded precaution assessment. These are selected items, not complete supply capture. Daily lot/item/stock-location CONSUME rows aggregate actual scalar events plus separately declared nonpatient waste. Independent event-time replay verifies eligibility at each use, rather than trusting an end-of-day stock total.
valuation: Prices are fictional supplier/base-unit inputs with explicit calendar price changes. New prices create new receipt lots. Transfer/return/reversal retain the original lot valuation. Purchases still on hand are inventory assets, not clinical consumption expense. Cycle-count loss and expiry are explicit nonclinical cost inputs. No balancing plug or untraceable cost is permitted. Fictional product planning rates, base-unit prices and the quarterly supplier-contract escalator are explicit configuration inputs. Receipt quantities use whole catalog packs; opening balances may be partially opened packs.
